notes: An Open Folder In entry in the right click menu, on a folder and on the background of any Finder window, with your apps flying out of it under the icon the mac already uses for each.

A default app, marked and first in the list, the way the Finder's own Open With marks a file's default. Pick it from your list, or pick Other and take any app this mac has, which adds it to your list on the way.

Arrives with Terminal and Finder. Everything else you add, from a dropdown of the apps this mac can already open a folder with, by choosing one out of your Applications folder, or from a bundle name you type.
Search your apps, drag them into the order the menu shows them in, and remove any of them. Remove them all and the menu goes back to looking untouched.
Choose where the menu appears: everywhere, or only in folders you pick.
Write your apps out to a file and bring them back in.
Opens at login, lives in the menu bar, and shows in the dock only while its window is open.
